verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm 1password.dev serves llms.txt and llms-full.txt, every docs page has a real .md mirror, and support.1password.com serves its own llms.txt of support guides. A public, keyless docs MCP server at 1password.dev/mcp completed a full initialize handshake, and the probed page is titled ai-readable-docs, so agents have several first-party, independently verified ways to consume the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: 1password.dev serves llms.txt ('# 1Password Developer Documentation') plus llms-full.txt, and every docs page has a real .md mirror
LLM-friendly exports of English public support guides from 1Password Support.
